#### 1. ADULT syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.791)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:15979)

**Proposed mechanism:** TP63 (HGNC:15979) —LEADS_TO→ Mouth abnormalities (HP:0000160); TP63 (HGNC:15979) —LEADS_TO→ Laryngeal hypoplasia (HP:0000776); TP63 (HGNC:15979) —LEADS_TO→ Limb malformations (HP:0001194); TP63 (HGNC:15979) —LEADS_TO→ Ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum (HP:0001111); TP63 (HGNC:15979) —LEADS_TO→ Ectodermal dysplasia (HP:0001049). Mutations in TP63 lead to haploinsufficiency, disrupting the normal development of ectodermal structures, limbs, and craniofacial features, manifesting as the overlapping phenotypes observed in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** The discovery of pathogenic variants in HGNC:15979 with a gain-of-function mechanism for either disease, or the identification of distinct causal genes for each disease that do not converge on TP63 function, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Pathogenic variants in HGNC:15979 with allele frequency > 0.01% in gnomAD.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism mediated by TP63 haploinsufficiency can inform the development of targeted therapies for both diseases, potentially focusing on modulating TP63 expression or downstream pathways to restore normal development and function.
